elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability coverage is required.

elements.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: No commercial general liability aggregate coverage is required.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required professional liability limit is only USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause requires only USD 2,000,000 of cyber and privacy liability insurance. It does not demonstrate that Customer Data processing is absent.

elements.element: Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
elements.evidence: No workers' compensation coverage requirement is included.

elements.element: Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.
elements.evidence: No duty to provide certificates of insurance is included.

elements.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Each Party other than Teleglobe USA Inc. must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Each Party other than Teleglobe USA Inc. must maintain cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.
